item.text:
Implemented a Rust 2021 project under `/output` with the entrypoint [test18.rs](/output/test18.rs) and modular library code in [src/sortedcontainers/sorted_map.rs](/output/src/sortedcontainers/sorted_map.rs) and [src/sortedcontainers/algorithms.rs](/output/src/sortedcontainers/algorithms.rs). The port uses a `BTreeMap`-backed `SortedMap`, preserves tuple-key ordering and `operator[]`-style default insertion, and includes an `atoi`-like parser so CLI behavior matches the C++ binary on inputs like `12abc`, `abc12`, `+5`, and leading whitespace.

Verification: `rustc --edition 2021 test18.rs -o test18` succeeded in `/output`, `cargo build --release` succeeded, and `/output/test18` matched `/workspace/dataset/test18_executable` byte-for-byte for representative inputs including `0..10`, `18`, `25`, `12abc`, `abc12`, `+5`, `-1`, and `""`.
